{{Quote|The leader and founder of the Aurodium Sword is a grizzled vet known as 'Muzzle.' Informants and intel confirm that he was part of the Alpha batch of ARCs&mdash;Alpha-66 to be exact|An excerpt from an Imperial Security Bureau report on the Aurodium Sword|<ref name="Underworld" />}}
'''Muzzle''', born with the designation '''Alpha-66''', was an [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] who fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], taking on the name 'Muzzle' during the closing stages of the war. After the end of the Clone Wars and the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Muzzle went on to organize his own [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group, the [[Aurodium Sword/Legends|Aurodium Sword]], offering his services as a bodyguard and a gun-for-hire to employers criminal and Imperial alike. However, Muzzle's treatment of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and other aliens as equal beings found him at odds with Imperial pro-[[Human/Legends|Human]] politics.

==Biography==
{{Quote|After the Clone Wars, a number of ARC-class clones deserted or were offered retirement. Many joined the Academy as instructors, but a few struck out on their own.|An excerpt from an Imperial Security Bureau report on the Aurodium Sword|<ref name="Underworld" />}}
[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] Alpha-66<ref name="Underworld" /> was one of the numerous [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Although most of Fett's clones were genetically altered to be more obedient to their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]],<ref name="Databank" /> Alpha-66 was one of the [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]],<ref name="Underworld" /> an elite group of one hundred clones produced from Fett's unaltered genome and trained by Fett himself. As a result, Muzzle inherited all of Fett's combat skills, but also his loner personality streak.<ref name="Guide">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> Alpha-66 fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], adopting the name "Muzzle" during the final stages of the conflict.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzzle}}</ref>

[[File:Dread_Strike.jpg|thumb|left|Snoova was a member of the Aurodium Sword.]]
After the end of the war and the [[Declaration of a New Order|reformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], all surviving ARCs were offered retirement. Some of them agreed and trained their successors, the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]; others decided to follow in their progenitor's footsteps and operate on their own. Muzzle chose the latter option, founding the [[Aurodium Sword/Legends|Aurodium Sword]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group<ref name="Underworld" />&mdash;named after the [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] mineral<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|42|Insider 89 "Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum & Villainy" Endnotes}}</ref>&mdash;offering protection to captains of industry and heads of state. The Aurodium Sword was staffed mainly by Humans, [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]], and fierce [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors such as the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Snoova]]. Muzzle's organization was known to take jobs for clients both criminal and Imperial, such as the [[Sienar family/Legends|Sienar family]].<ref name="Underworld" />

On one occasion, Muzzle, Snoova, and another Wookiee defended a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] executive against an industrial [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. Muzzle and the Aurodium Sword were still active [[0 ABY/Legends|shortly after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. As part of its program of tracking rogue Fett clones, the Rogue Cell of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] kept a close eye on Muzzle and his organization, considering their loyalty to the Empire to be undecided. The Imperial agents, however, were concerned with Muzzle's treatment of Wookiees<ref name="Underworld" /> and other species<ref name="CSWE" /> as equal beings, which clashed with the Empire's [[Humanocentrism|humanocentristic]] views.<ref name="Underworld" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Aurodium sword has taken jobs for clients both Imperial (the Sienar family), and criminal, so the organization's loyalty to the Empire cannot be gauged at this time. However, Muzzle's employment and treatment of Wookiees as actual free beings is troublesome.|An excerpt from an Imperial Security Bureau report on the Aurodium Sword|<ref name="Underworld" />}}
A grizzled Clone Wars veteran,<ref name="Underworld" /> recognized for his service in the Republic army even by Imperial military personnel,<ref name="CSWE" /> Muzzle inherited Jango Fett's sense of adventure and contempt to any form of authority.<ref name="Blog" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Muzzle was considered atypically long-lived for a clone.<ref name="Appendix">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/89/indexp3.html|text=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues|int=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues}}</ref> Although the Empire treated other species, especially Wookiees, as inferior to [[Human/Legends|Humans]], Muzzle considered them equal in every sense, causing some concern for the Imperial Security Bureau with such views,<ref name="Underworld" /> a fact that he was aware of.<ref name="CSWE" /> At some point in his life, he received a prominent X-shaped scar across his forehead. Muzzle wore a combined armor set&mdash;while the upper half was [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC trooper armor]], complete with a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]]; the lower half came from the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Palace Guard]] uniform.<ref name="Underworld" /> Such a combination offered him both good protection and freedom of movement, as Muzzle's experience had taught him that sometimes it was better to run as fast as possible. While choosing the name for his organization, Muzzle wanted it to project an aura of class, intelligence, and purity, and he eventually settled upon the valuable aurodium.<ref name="Blog" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It struck a chord with me, though, and I thought, "Boy, who wouldn't want to have a trio of huge Wookiees backing him up?" I remember when I was a kid, thinking that Chewbacca was the strongest alien in the galaxy. How awesome would it be to team up a grizzled super-soldier with a bunch of the biggest, meanest guard dogs you've ever seen!??|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog" />}}
The character of Muzzle was conceived by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] for his and [[Abel G. Peña]]'s article ''[[Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy]]'', which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 89|''Star Wars Insider'' 89]] in [[August]] of [[2006]]. [[Joe Corroney]] provided the artwork depicting Muzzle for the article. Kaufman came up with the concept of a clone trooper veteran backed by Wookiee warriors when he witnessed his five-year-old son, Max, playing with action figures of a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] and three Wookiees. As Kaufman had an unofficial agreement with [[Karen Traviss]], the author of the [[Republic Commando|''Republic commando'' novel series]], which prevented him from using [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], he decided to make his character an Alpha-class ARC, a concept he had co-developed with [[W. Haden Blackman|Haden Blackman]] and that he had wanted to explore for a long time. Kaufman was very pleased with Corroney's artistic interpretation of Muzzle. Muzzle's grim determination, graying temples, and the X-shaped scar reminded Kaufman of [[Wikipedia:John Hartigan|Detective John Hartigan]] from the [[Wikipedia:That Yellow Bastard|''Sin City: That Yellow Bastard'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series by [[Wikipedia:Frank Miller (comics)|Frank Miller]].<ref name="Blog" />
